summary: Feed s074_single to APM is degraded due to 20.3% duplicate packets (871/4295, threshold 5%). All other checks (one-way, drops, overload, VLAN, encryption) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Systematic duplication in visibility path — typically overlapping SPAN/mirror sessions or dual TAP feeds aggregated to the same packet broker output without deduplication, forwarding the same packet twice to the APM port.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM will double-count transactions, inflate throughput and latency metrics, misclassify duplicates as retransmissions, and waste 20% of processing/storage on redundant packets, degrading detection accuracy and capacity.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication on the feed to drop identical packets within a short window before delivery, eliminating 20% redundant load while preserving unique traffic for accurate APM analysis.
